title: Evaluation Metrics — One Curve Hides a Rare Class
key_insight: ROC AUC measures ranking across thresholds. Precision-recall area focuses more directly on the rare positive class and can be more revealing.
body:
## One Curve Hides a Rare Class

A fraud model has impressive ROC area because millions of ordinary cases keep the false-positive rate small, yet its alerts are mostly wrong.

ROC AUC measures ranking across thresholds. Precision-recall area focuses more directly on the rare positive class and can be more revealing.

Also check calibration: among predictions near 70%, roughly seven in ten should happen. Ranking and trustworthy probability are different qualities.
common_mistakes: Using accuracy for a rare positive class.
Comparing AUC without choosing a deployment threshold.
Treating a tiny metric difference as meaningful without uncertainty.
mini_exercise: Draw the situation from “One Curve Hides a Rare Class” with three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: The wrong metric rewards the wrong model, especially with rare events.
explain_back_prompt: Using the “One Curve Hides a Rare Class” story, explain Evaluation Metrics without assuming the listener knows machine learning.
